units.source_text: 上学前的这一段时间，我一直坐在自己的房间里，任凭心脏越来越剧烈地跳动。

en.t: During the time before school, I sat in my room the whole while, letting my heart beat more and more violently.

units.source_text: 迄今我不曾抱希望等待着什么。

en.t: Until now, I had never waited for anything with hope.

units.source_text: 如今分明是期待老师的憎恨才干出来的，

en.t: Now it was clearly something I had managed to do only because I expected the teacher's hatred,

units.source_text: 不料我心中却在幻想洋溢着人际相互理解的戏剧性的热情的场面。

en.t: yet unexpectedly, in my heart I was imagining dramatic, passionate scenes overflowing with mutual understanding between people.
